title: snd.play~
description: `snd.play~` is a multichannel sound-file player that supports variable-speed playback, pausing, seeking, looping, and optional time-stretching with pitch-shift correction. Specify 1–32 output channels as the first argument and an absolute or patch-relative sound-file name as the second; a float at the inlet starts playback with 1 and stops it with 0.
